name: Maison na Yatsura ~Yaru Koto wa Issho~
original_name: めぞんなやつら～やることはいっしょ～
source:
Main character happens to live with four girls at the same time. Will he only have lots of fun or take one of the girls to the altar?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-december-2000-never7-end-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角同時與四名女孩住在一起。他會僅僅享受無盡的歡樂，還是牽起其中一位走上紅毯？
